FILM DESCRIPTION: 
Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent.

recentItems.title: Mark Duplass Talks 'The Creep Tapes' Season 3, Peachfuzz & Indie Filmmaking
recentItems.description:
On today's episode of the Awards Tour podcast, Rotten Tomatoes Awards Editor Jacqueline Coley sits down with writer, director, producer, and actor Mark Duplass to talk about Season 3 of 'The Creep Tapes.' In their chat, Duplass shares how he developed Peachfuzz, a character searching for connection, how the series grew out of the cult-favorite 'Creep' films, and how he picks the actors who become his latest “victims.”

Duplass also looks back at his wide-ranging career, from indie films like 'Language Lessons' to Apple TV+’s 'The Morning Show,' and offers advice for young filmmakers finding their way in a changing entertainment industry.

Check out all three seasons of 'The Creep Tapes' on AMC+, and we'll see you on the next stop on the Awards Tour.
